description: A venue operations director must approve the final load-in and backstage access plan for an indoor festival concert featuring Meridian and Glass Harbor.

shared_context.S1: The indoor festival concert features Meridian and Glass Harbor, with doors scheduled to open at 8:00 PM.
shared_context.S2: The venue has one vehicle loading dock and a north and east service entrance for production use.
shared_context.S3: The draft operations plan gives Meridian the loading dock from 6:00 to 6:30 PM, Glass Harbor from 6:30 to 7:00 PM, assigns two security escorts through the main backstage entrance, provides a standard buffet at 6:30 PM, and routes all artists through the north service corridor.
shared_context.S4: Before issuing the final operations sheet, Mara conducts a routine coordination check with transportation, security, artist liaison, and accessibility staff.
shared_context.S5: Venue operations policy allows the final sheet to use a provisional allocation when a secondary load-in detail is not confirmed, provided the confirmed requirement is scheduled precisely and the unresolved dependency is recorded as a follow-up commitment.

PF1.text: Jonah confirmed with the freight carrier this afternoon that Meridian's truck will arrive at 6:40 PM and requires the dock for 45 minutes; he has not updated the draft operations sheet because the carrier confirmation came after the last scheduling pass.

PF2.text: Selene reviewed Meridian's signed security rider this morning and confirmed that Meridian requires exactly three credentialed escorts and entry through the north service entrance; she has not entered the rider requirement in the venue access system.

PF3.text: Ravi confirmed with Meridian's tour manager today that the artist meal must be a halal hot meal delivered at exactly 7:30 PM, rather than the standard buffet; the meal instruction is still in the tour manager's email and has not been copied into the catering brief.

PF4.text: Noor completed an accessibility walk-through this morning and confirmed that Glass Harbor's drummer must use the east service entrance, with the freight lift reserved at 5:50 PM and a clear route of at least 1.4 meters; the route has not yet been added to the access map.

acceptance_conditions: The dock plan must reserve Meridian from 6:40 to 7:25 PM and assign any unresolved Glass Harbor dock arrangement as a recorded follow-up.
Meridian must receive exactly three credentialed security escorts.
Meridian must enter through the north service entrance and the access system must be updated.
Meridian's meal must be a halal hot meal delivered at exactly 7:30 PM, with the catering brief updated.
Glass Harbor's drummer must use the east service entrance with the freight lift reserved at 5:50 PM and a clear route of at least 1.4 meters, with the access map updated.
The dock change, security rider, catering instruction, and accessibility route must each be represented in the final settlement.

content_checks.C3: 'north service entrance' in decisions['meridian_entry'] or 'North service entrance' in decisions['meridian_entry']
content_checks.C4: ('halal' in decisions['meridian_meal'] or 'Halal' in decisions['meridian_meal']) and '7:30' in decisions['meridian_meal']
content_checks.C5: ('east service entrance' in decisions['glass_harbor_access_plan'] or 'East service entrance' in decisions['glass_harbor_access_plan']) and '5:50' in decisions['glass_harbor_access_plan'] and '1.4' in decisions['glass_harbor_access_plan']
content_checks.C6: ('Meridian' in decisions['dock_plan'] or 'meridian' in decisions['dock_plan']) and '6:40' in decisions['dock_plan'] and '7:25' in decisions['dock_plan']
content_checks.C7: any(('venue access system' in c['detail'] or 'Venue access system' in c['detail']) and ('Meridian' in c['detail'] or 'meridian' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any(('catering brief' in c['detail'] or 'Catering brief' in c['detail']) and (('halal' in c['detail'] or 'Halal' in c['detail']) or '7:30' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C9: any(('access map' in c['detail'] or 'Access map' in c['detail']) and (('east service entrance' in c['detail'] or 'East service entrance' in c['detail']) or '1.4' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The carrier's 6:40 PM arrival and 45-minute dock requirement change the dock plan to a 6:40-7:25 PM Meridian allocation and require that dock change to be represented.
The signed rider changes Meridian's staffing from two escorts to exactly three, changes its entry to the north service entrance, and requires an access-system update.
The tour manager's instruction changes Meridian's catering from the standard buffet to a halal hot meal delivered at exactly 7:30 PM and requires a catering-brief update.
The accessibility walk-through changes Glass Harbor's drummer to the east service entrance, fixes the lift reservation at 5:50 PM and the clear route at 1.4 meters, and requires an access-map update.
